row.notes: Logs Save selected requested for %s / result. Called by Ne_SaveSystem_SelectAndSave. When device+0x3e8 (m_storeInCloud) and the helper are set it brackets the save with ISteamRemoteStorage BeginFileWriteBatch +0x1c8 / EndFileWriteBatch +0x1d0 through helper+0x108, around Ne_SaveSystem2Win_Mount (for saving), Ne_SaveSystem2Win_ReadSecurityInfoFile and Game_Save_UnmountSave (which FileWrite +0x00s each mounted file). | Performs one selected save: logs 'Save selected requested for %s' (param_3+0x18 = save name), self vcall +0x60 lock, serialiser (self[2]) begin via vtable +0x50 or +0x30/+0x38 (param_5 path), optional UI busy via self[6]+0x108 vcall +0x1c8/+0x1d0 when self+0x3e8 set, then Ne_SaveSystem2Win_Mount(forSaving=1) -> Ne_SaveSystem2Win_ProcessSerialiserActions -> Game_Save_UnmountSave(commit), serialiser end vcall +0x58/+0x48, unlock vcall +0x68, logs 'Save selected result: 0x%x'. Callers Ne_SaveSystem_SelectAndSave 0x14414014b, 0x1441402ac. Addon: hook entry/exit to know when a save starts and finishes plus its result.
